candidate_diagnostics.same_state_vs_between_checkpoint: Within each row group, all rules use a common checkpoint and inputs. Across full/half checkpoints, parameters differ from training. Ratios across checkpoint groups are not causal effects.
candidate_diagnostics.interpretation_boundary: Nonzero route-sensitive VJPs and zero measured forward differences are observed. Scalar moment matching does not preserve measured accumulated gradients. No training-energy, supervised-loss mediation, semantic or generalization claim.

observations.statement: All 41 authorized model trials succeeded with null errors; previous_runtime_error is null. Earlier count/product/gradient/action/mean branches include scientific negatives, not failed training executions. Round12 submission notes preserve a repaired local harness extraction failure; current retrieval truncation and missing validator are separate preparation/availability issues.

Feature-only, pooled and target-aware references have AUC 0.6050036144838207, 0.6102261137080656 and 0.6133619861190683. Useful history signal is observed, without identifying behavior semantics as its cause.

Full behavior-count correction lowers pooling and DIN AUC; half correction helps pooling but still lowers DIN AUC. The weaker follow-up did not rescue the target-aware branch. Joint product restrictions improve the ordinary product adapter; separate restriction cells and their interaction prevent attributing the whole gain to one removal.

Aligned unit products improve aligned raw AUC; crossed normalization does little for AUC and worsens loss. The original full derivative beats detached, identity and unit-scale tangent rules, but later fixed-0.2 tangent/identity replacements approach full AUC. Precise adaptive scale and projection necessity are unestablished.

Whole-history mean is near full/fixed in AUC with worse Logloss. Chronological half-rotation, action-half and action-mean lose AUC; adjacent replacements recover in both groupings. These negative outcomes remain valid and rule-specific.

The ordering-by-offset AUC interaction is -0.0003459909071475975: chronological adjacent-minus-half is +0.00026890848463556605, rank adjacent-minus-half is -0.00007708242251203146. Rank-half leads AUC while rank-adjacent leads Logloss; the AUC reversal does not imply a matching loss reversal.

Round13 full and scale-half audits exactly reproduce their ancestor AUC, Logloss, population size and all 23 slice metrics/counts. The retained AUC incumbent is r0012-scale_half at 0.6151021885074872. The audit does not improve the incumbent or add a seed.

At each audited checkpoint, candidate-authored diagnostics report zero common-state forward logit discrepancy on first512 and probe32 inputs. Rotations conserve scale sums/squared sums to about 2.05e-7 relative error; all ten synthetic VJP modes have scaled error below 3.61e-15, two probes per mode, including synthetic boundary/floor cases. Natural sampled events contain no floor/boundary cases.

At the full checkpoint, rank-half versus full mean-logit product VJP has norm ratio 1.4980837793212165, relative difference 0.6337797319593742, cosine 0.9487380791448279; the shared category/brand embedding VJP has norm ratio 1.053495212768841, relative difference 0.1563018947792516, cosine 0.9897633239987006. Rank-adjacent differences are smaller (product 0.1389281376801338, embedding 0.019811921013951118). At the half checkpoint, corresponding half differences are 0.5607598428134419 and 0.1639947210932855 versus adjacent 0.11652242937262229 and 0.02083977335714413. Each comparison is within one common checkpoint; the two checkpoints are learned outcomes.

Scale-half audit exceeds full by 0.00012049732767249743 AUC and reduces Logloss by 0.000030823655909423264, but loses both metrics on empty/1-16 histories and frequency_1_2. It beats full in 15/23 AUC and 16/23 loss slices; these overlapping exploratory slices are not independent replications.

Both audits have 17130275 parameters, 17078688 embedding and 51587 dense. Wall times are 615.1613 and 626.4336 seconds, training times 525.6302 and 535.3749 seconds; memory is 832739328 and 835099136 bytes. Cost differences are descriptive; allocated GPU seconds, exact training examples and controlled repeated latency are unexported.

interpretations.statement: The new audit supplies bounded common-state evidence of nonzero routing effects on product and shared embedding VJPs while preserving measured forward values. It addresses the previous missing-gradient-observation gap only for these first32 mean-logit probes.
interpretations.qualification: Candidate-supplied measurement, not independent source verification, supervised loss gradient, parameter update or performance mediation.

interpretations.statement: Scalar scale first/second-moment conservation does not imply equality of the measured accumulated gradient: both norms and directions differ. This directly contradicts exact gradient equality for these probes, without establishing training update energy or an efficiency mechanism.
interpretations.qualification: The norms aggregate raw product gradients or unique shared embedding weights, which have different geometry and include other embedding routes.

interpretations.statement: Rank-adjacent stays much closer to full gradients than rank-half in the measured probes at both checkpoints, yet rank-half has the numerical AUC lead and rank-adjacent lower loss. A monotonic smaller-gradient-perturbation account of AUC superiority is not identified.
interpretations.qualification: The observed within-checkpoint ordering is not a controlled intervention on gradient distance alone; comparisons across checkpoints are descriptive.

interpretations.statement: Earlier temporal proximity/positive scale-correlation explanations remain insufficient. Rank-half has sampled own/donor scale correlation near -0.344 and retains the AUC lead, while chronological half loses. The rule/order matters provisionally; neither negative correlation nor temporal or action semantics is identified as causal.

The audit reduces concern that the added diagnostic path changed aggregate training results, but deterministic replay and algebraic probe consistency do not establish independent replication, population-wide isolation or reliable improvement.

No new training mechanism or forward architecture was introduced in round13. Its contribution is measurement of already executed backward rules. Literature priority and general mechanism superiority remain unverified.

Do not relabel these as validation-label gradients or claim source-level verification.
candidate_diagnostics.control_missingness: The disabled control has call_index=-1 and completed_snapshots=0. Its snapshot zeros are placeholders for unmeasured values, not evidence of zero gradients or effects.
candidate_diagnostics.finite_nonzero_check: Both enabled slots are complete with finite positive reference gradients and sample/positive counts; all five alternatives have nonzero product and embedding differences.

algebraic_consistency.identity: d^2 = r^2 + 1 - 2*r*cosine, where d=relative gradient difference and r=norm ratio
algebraic_consistency.qualification: Consistent within1e-7 absolute squared units, allowing reported float rounding/cancellation near cosine1. This is a coarse internal consistency check, not an independent gradient measurement, especially at initialization.

round13_context.reported_scope: First32 ordered validation mean-logit VJPs at each of two learned checkpoints; first512 forward/scale checks.
round13_context.comparison_limit: The latest objective, batch size, exposure composition and training state differ. Do not interpret the smaller latest relative differences as attenuation caused by supervision or as a time trend across studies.

candidate_diagnostics.interpretation_boundary: Reported gradients are for raw product vectors and selected shared category/brand embedding weights. No all-parameter gradients, Adam moments, actual optimizer deltas, path decomposition or performance mediation are measured. Between-call BCE and gradient changes use different states and batches; no causal learning-speed conclusion.

observations.statement: All43 allowed trials succeeded operationally with null errors. Count correction, crossed products, several gradient replacements and action/mean branches contain scientific negative results, not failed model executions. No unreported failures are inferred.

Static, pooled and target-aware reference AUCs are0.6050036145,0.6102261137,0.6133619861. History contributes predictive signal under the frozen benchmark; this alone does not identify behavior semantics.
Full count correction lowers pooling and DIN AUC. Half correction improves pooling relative to ordinary pooling but still lowers DIN AUC; a weaker follow-up did not rescue the target-aware mechanism.

Aligned product restrictions improve the ordinary adapter; their single-factor cells interact. The ordinary adapter itself differs slightly from original DIN, so its joint gain must be measured against its own bridge. Aligned normalization improves AUC more than crossed normalization.

Full normalized-product differentiation beats detached, unit-scale identity and unit-scale tangent at seed42, but fixed0.2 tangent/identity nearly recover full AUC. Neither exact own-event inverse scaling nor tangent projection is established as necessary.

Whole-history mean is close in AUC with worse loss; chronological half, action-half and action-mean lose AUC. Adjacent replacements recover in both groupings. These negative controls delimit specific implementations rather than refute all behavior-aware modeling.

The ordering-by-offset AUC interaction is-0.0003459909071475975: chronological adjacent-minus-half=+0.00026890848463556605, rank adjacent-minus-half=-0.00007708242251203146. Rank-half leads AUC; rank-adjacent has lower Logloss. Temporal adjacency is not identified as necessary.

Both round14 variants reproduce incumbent AUC0.6151021885074872, Logloss0.19653258393542125 and all23 slice metrics/counts exactly, including round13 scale-half. This supports aggregate nonperturbation of the loss hook/probes at seed42; it supplies no new performance improvement or independent repetition.

The enabled audit reports exactly two nondegenerate supervised snapshots: calls0/512;4096 examples each;193/220 positives;488394/490380 eligible events. All six rules have identical reported logits and BCE within each snapshot. All five alternative backward rules change raw-product and selected embedding gradients relative to full.

Scale-half product relative differences are0.4022149641/0.4203417826 and embedding relative differences0.0010647156/0.0160164880. Scale-adjacent differences are0.1387895370/0.1244350410 and0.0001236034/0.0017689983. Near-unit embedding norm ratios do not mean equal gradient vectors.

The disabled audit has no snapshots; call indices-1 mark all corresponding zeros as unavailable measurements. Generic diagnostic scope metadata differs from the candidate-described training-snapshot provenance and remains an explicit limitation.

The incumbent exceeds full AUC by0.0001204973 and lowers loss by0.0000308237, while harming empty/short-history and frequency1-2 slices. These overlapping exploratory comparisons do not establish uniform or statistically reliable improvement.

Latest enabled versus disabled instrumentation adds14.5249257 seconds wall,14.8383453 seconds training and713158656 bytes peak memory with equal17130275 parameters. Both are complete matched-recipe runs; this is descriptive diagnostic overhead, not an efficiency claim.

interpretations.statement: Round14 narrows the prior objective-gradient evidence gap: donor replacements measurably affect reported mean-BCE product and category/brand embedding gradients at two common training states, beyond the older label-free endpoint probes.
interpretations.qualification: Conditional on candidate instrumentation and its training provenance. Two batches on one trajectory, not independently verified population or update evidence.

interpretations.statement: Conserving scalar scale moments does not force equality of the reported supervised accumulated embedding gradients. The small differences at embedding level could reflect other paths, sharing, cancellation or scaling; these explanations have not been separated.

Scale-adjacent perturbs the measured full gradient less than scale-half in both supervised snapshots, while scale-half has the numerical AUC lead and scale-adjacent lower loss. A monotonic closer-to-full-gradient explanation of the AUC ordering is unsupported.
interpretations.qualification: Cross-rule gradient distance is not an isolated treatment, and the snapshots are on the scale-half trajectory. This does not establish larger perturbations as beneficial.

interpretations.statement: Exact metric and slice replay reduces concern that the declared mean-BCE hook or probes changed aggregate selected results; it cannot establish identical optimizer states, sample predictions or checkpoints.

Observed rule sensitivity is compatible with optimization effects under a common forward and capacity. No recorded Adam state or update intervenes between measured gradient differences and validation outcomes; causal mediation, action/temporal semantics and population generality remain unestablished.
Round14 is a measurement extension of existing mechanisms. It does not add a forward architecture, new donor rule, independent seed or verified literature contribution.

alternatives.discriminating_check: Precommit the existing six-arm suite at permitted paired seeds43/44; report every result, paired mean/range and interaction without opening a donor sweep.

alternatives.discriminating_check: A permitted path-decomposed VJP at the same batch/state could separate product-path changes from total embedding cancellation. Current scalar summaries do not identify it.

alternatives.discriminating_check: Only a later authorized matched-state gradient-plus-optimizer-state/update contrast could test this. No update is inferred from norm ratios or cosine; no optimizer change is proposed now.

observations.statement: All45 exposed model trials succeeded with null errors; latest runtime error is null. Scientific null/negative branches and repaired preparation failures are retained separately.
History pooling improves static AUC by0.0052224992; target-aware pooling adds0.0031358724. This establishes useful history signal under this benchmark, not semantic relevance.
Full count correction hurts pooling and target-aware AUC. Half correction helps pooling but still hurts target-aware AUC. The partial follow-up did not rescue that mechanism.

Aligned raw product restrictions improve the ordinary adapter; off-diagonal removal alone also helps. Unit normalization helps aligned AUC far more than crossed AUC. Original DIN differs from the ordinary adapter and cannot replace its immediate control.

Detached, identity and tangent-only replacements failed to beat full normalized aligned. Fixed0.2 tangent/identity later nearly recover full AUC. Exact own-event inverse scales and tangent projection have not been shown necessary.

Chronological half-rotation, action-half and action-mean lose AUC; whole-history mean is near full but worse in loss. Adjacent replacements recover in both groupings. Rank ordering reverses the chronological adjacent-versus-half AUC ordering. These failures limit individual implementations, not all multi-behavior modeling.
Query-only routing AUC0.6149975213 is nearly full with worse loss; history-only AUC0.6148160125 is lower with slightly better loss. Neither improves incumbent AUC0.6151021885 or its loss0.1965325839.

The role factorial AUC interaction is+0.00027034593078789637; Logloss interaction is-0.00005161847028653521. Both routing beats the additive AUC prediction0.6148318426. The prospectively declared sign is observed at this single seed.
Candidate diagnostics report common-state forward equality and accurate synthetic role VJPs; bounded measurements do not supply training-role cancellation or actual update evidence.

Earlier two training-BCE probes already showed changed product and selected shared embedding VJPs; the new interventions now vary roles during training, but no new training-loss path decomposition is reported.

Aggregate interaction is heterogeneous across exploratory counted slices; the same role interaction is not positive in every group. Empty-history score changes cannot be direct effects of attended history events.

All four role cells have17,130,275 parameters. Single-role wall times625.06/629.62s and peaks871,668,224/872,716,288 bytes do not establish an efficiency gain. Historical both/full timing uses different source implementations and instrumentation.

diagnostic_interpretation.provenance: All diagnostics are candidate-supplied, not independently verified. Generic wrapper scope says first 512 validation impressions/frozen best checkpoint, while train_* keys and notes describe cached training calls 0/512. Preserve this discrepancy.
diagnostic_interpretation.training_scope: Two 4096-example batches with 193/220 positives, one trajectory per arm. Call 0 is a common initial scalar BCE; call 512 has different learned states. Do not treat cross-arm later snapshots as matched-state interventions or training-speed effects.
diagnostic_interpretation.manipulation_checks: Within each state, reported intended-gradient relative errors <3.4e-8, matched product-sum norm error <2.2e-7, unchanged BCE scalar/padding correction error 0. Synthetic projection and surrogate checks pass; these support internal consistency only.
diagnostic_interpretation.negative_row_alignment: Half-project conflicting rows are 1102/2441 and 1053/2413. The aggregate role cosine is positive (0.1523964/0.0774244); many negative per-row inner products can coexist with this. Row count fraction is not a magnitude-weighted share of total loss or update.
diagnostic_interpretation.unchanged_path_dilution: Half-project unchanged-path norms are 0.0009689061/0.0004449176, while summed product norms are 0.00000377114/0.0000189030. Correction/complete embedding gradient norm is about 0.000600/0.007964. Near-unit total norm ratios do not imply identical gradients or negligible coordinate effects.
diagnostic_interpretation.matching_boundary: The norm control retains the original product-role sum direction at the norm of a hypothetical projection at its own state. It does not match complete embedding-gradient norms after adding unchanged paths, all-parameter gradients, accumulated Adam moments, update norms or independently trained trajectories. Projection and control call-512 states differ.
diagnostic_interpretation.validation_scope: 512 ordered validation examples have zero reported common-state forward difference and padding mass, zero empty summary norm, and attention sum error <=2.3842e-7. This is a bounded consistency check, not population coverage, equal fitted predictions or an assessment of unseen/missing fields.
diagnostic_interpretation.synthetic_scope: Synthetic probes include one eligible row and two conflicting rows. The difference signals in projection/control direction are nonzero. Small designed checks do not establish real-population prevalence or optimizer correctness.
diagnostic_interpretation.unmeasured: No independent training-gradient audit, actual Adam moments/updates, late-training representativeness or causal mediation estimate. Earlier disabled snapshot slots with call=-1 remain unavailable, never zero effects.

slice_analysis.bin_policy: Inherited host bins, not selected using latest outcomes. History bins empty/1–16/17–64/>64, four clock bins, behavior presence, category match and training-frequency groups. Exact endpoint semantics and training-derived definitions beyond receipt labels are not independently exported.
slice_analysis.counts: Counts match across compared arms and positives+negatives=samples. All 23 latest reported slices have both classes; no undefined AUC. No predeclared power threshold or independent user counts, so finite AUC is not evidence of sufficient precision.
slice_analysis.overlap: Slices overlap; exposure rows cluster by user. Their AUC deltas cannot be sample-weight averaged into global AUC.
slice_analysis.missing: Unseen/missing-field slices and uncapped history-length detail are unavailable. Do not invent or infer them from category-match absence.
slice_analysis.interpretation: Uniform benefit is already contradicted descriptively. Empty-history AUC falls by 0.0031229 versus prior half and 0.0011010 versus norm control, with only 310 positives. These fitted-model changes can arise from shared training parameters and cannot be direct effects of attended events in an empty inference history. No slice significance or semantic causality claim.

observations.statement: All 49 authorized committed model trials have status success and null error; runtime previous_runtime_error is null. They include scientific negatives and deterministic replays, not 49 independent seeds. Independently resolved receipts agree with all supplied index entries and all 15 full runtime records.
Pooling improves static AUC by 0.0052224992; target-aware pooling adds 0.0031358724. These establish predictive history signal under the frozen benchmark, without identifying semantic relevance.
Full count correction hurts pooling and target-aware AUC; half correction improves pooling but still hurts target-aware AUC. The partial follow-up did not rescue the target-aware implementation.

The joint aligned product restriction improves its ordinary adapter by 0.0011629547 AUC; single-factor restriction effects interact. Ordinary adapter differs from original DIN by -0.00003090639 AUC, so immediate controls matter. Unit normalization improves aligned AUC far more than crossed AUC.

Detached, identity and tangent-only backward replacements lose to full normalization; constant-0.2 tangent and identity nearly recover its AUC. Exact own-event inverse scale and tangent projection have not been established as necessary for the observed AUC level.

Chronological half-rotation, action-half and action-mean lose AUC; history mean nearly matches full AUC with worse loss. Adjacent replacements recover in both groupings, but inverse-norm rank ordering reverses the adjacent-versus-half AUC ordering. These retain negative trajectories and limit temporal/action-specific explanations.

Round-13/14 audit bridges reproduce historical full/half validation metrics and slices. Round-15 single-role variants fail to beat joint half; the role-routing outcome interaction is +0.0002703459 AUC and -0.00005161847 Logloss. This is performance nonadditivity, not direct evidence of cancellation.

Round-16 half_project is the recorded maximum AUC: 0.6151301693553729, Logloss 0.19654013321576363. It adds 0.00002798084788568911 AUC over prior half with Logloss worse by 0.0000075492803423837795. Its +0.0017681832363045658 AUC over original DIN includes all inherited changes and cannot be attributed to projection.

Projection-minus-norm AUC gains are +0.0001943264312 under full and +0.0002545079250 under half. Corresponding Logloss changes are +0.00001794284042 and +0.000001655876722. Both norm controls lose AUC relative to no intervention; projection-versus-none gains are much smaller.

The gradient-rule by projection-versus-norm AUC interaction is +0.00006018149377440274; loss interaction is -0.000016286963698208812. Against no surgery the corresponding AUC interaction is +0.000012182628297163767. Distinct baselines answer distinct questions.

Candidate-authored round-16 snapshots report active shared rows 2441/2413 and conflict fractions about 0.44–0.47 at calls 0/512. Half-project has 1102/1053 conflicting rows and correction/total-gradient norm ratios 0.0005998703/0.0079636991. Positive aggregate query/history cosines coexist with negative row inner products.

All latest variants report two completed training snapshots, zero BCE scalar error and padding correction, intended-gradient relative errors below 3.4e-8, per-row hypothetical projection/control norm error below 2.2e-7, and zero first-512 forward difference. These are candidate-supplied checks with unresolved generic validation-scope metadata.

Half-project has exploratory AUC reversals versus prior half in empty, mid-length and several hour/behavior/frequency slices; projection-versus-norm also loses AUC for empty/short histories and past-pv-absent. Empty histories have 8272 exposures/310 positives; low counts and user dependence prevent precision claims.

All history candidates here retain 17130275 parameters. Half-project versus prior half costs +33.0691 seconds wall, +32.5795 seconds training and +156659200 bytes peak memory. Its measured throughput is 171877.6571 examples/s and batch p50/p95 22.1175/22.9790 ms. This is a matched-recipe comparison, not equal compute.

conceptual_algebra.definitions: Let a_r and b_r be product-query/history gradients aggregated at shared row r, v_r=a_r+b_r, and U_r all unchanged embedding paths.
conceptual_algebra.project: On eligible negative-inner-product rows, symmetric removal corresponds conceptually to a'_r=a_r-(a_r·b_r)/||b_r||² b_r and b'_r=b_r-(a_r·b_r)/||a_r||² a_r; use t_r=a'_r+b'_r. Other rows remain as declared.
conceptual_algebra.norm_control: Use n_r=(||t_r||/||v_r||)v_r on valid matching rows, subject to actual source safeguards. Matching ||n_r|| and ||t_r|| concerns this subcomponent only.
conceptual_algebra.total: New total embedding gradient is U_r+t_r or U_r+n_r. Equal subcomponent norms generally do not imply equal total norms or equal Adam updates.
conceptual_algebra.loss: Receipt describes a detached correction yielding unchanged scalar mean BCE but changed gradient. It is a deliberate surrogate training rule, not proof that the same numerical forward loss has a different ordinary derivative.

mechanism_definition.scope: Receipt-described conceptual algebra, conditional on safeguards and accumulation implementation. No source bodies are exported in this phase.
mechanism_definition.inherited: Frozen category/brand/action/time histories and masks, shared category/brand tables, aligned unit-normalized products, scale_half_tangent routing, target-aware masked-softmax pooling, MLP, scalar mean BCE, Adam and the training/checkpoint recipe. No extra learned capacity.
mechanism_definition.definitions: At shared category/brand row r, let a and b be supervised product-query/history gradients, G the full gradient including all other paths U, and delta the inherited symmetric conflict-projection change to a+b. P=G+delta on common eligible/finite/nondegenerate rows. Noneligible rows retain G.
mechanism_definition.matching_boundary: D preserves the complete shared-row norm and substitutes P direction. M preserves complete shared-row G direction and substitutes P norm. Matching occurs per row at the arm's own current state, not across diverged trajectories or all optimizer parameters.
mechanism_definition.old_control_difference: Round16 norm_match matched only the projected product-role sum norm before U was added. Equal subcomponent norm did not imply equal complete gradient norm.
mechanism_definition.loss_boundary: Detached surrogate corrections leave numerical BCE unchanged while intentionally replacing its backward rule. They are not ordinary derivatives of an unchanged scalar function, a new forward attention block, or a test-label use.
mechanism_definition.optimizer_boundary: Complete raw-gradient factorization does not factor Adam updates or moments. Row magnitude may change coordinatewise optimizer state and subsequent directions.

observations.statement: All 53 authorized committed trials succeed operationally with null errors; previous_runtime_error is null. All index entries and 15 supplied full runtime records agree with independently resolved receipts. Scientific negative branches are not failed executions.

Pooling adds 0.0052224992 validation AUC over static; target-aware pooling adds 0.0031358724 over pooling. Both reduce Logloss. This establishes useful history signal within the inherited frozen benchmark.

Full count correction reduces AUC in both history references. Half correction improves simple pooling but still reduces target-aware AUC; the discriminating weaker-strength follow-up did not rescue that implementation.

Aligned product restriction improves its ordinary adapter; unit normalization helps aligned far more than crossed products. The ordinary adapter differs slightly from original DIN, so use immediate controls.

Full normalized backward beats detached/identity/tangent-only variants, but fixed-0.2 scales nearly recover its AUC. History mean nearly matches full AUC with worse loss. Count/action/donor negatives and adjacent/order recoveries limit exact-event and temporal-necessity explanations.

The role-routing factorial has nonadditive optimized validation outcomes. Round 16 reports negative shared-row role dots and positive projection-versus-product-sum-norm AUC contrasts, but both controls degrade versus no surgery and their norm matching omits unchanged paths.

Latest AUC order is magnitude M > projection P > none N > direction D. M-N is +0.0001774051692 AUC, D-N is -0.0003123227105, P-M is -0.0000886310700. M has slightly worse Logloss than N and markedly worse loss than P.
P-D is +0.0004010968098 AUC. P-D-M+N is +0.0002236916405 AUC and -0.0000736864603 Logloss. Both direction AUC effects are negative; positive interaction does not make direction beneficial.

The new none bridge exactly matches historical half AUC, Logloss and all exported slices. The projection bridge does not: P minus old half_project is +0.0000607932514 AUC and -0.0000441208413 Logloss despite equal configs and different source hashes.

M is the numerical AUC maximum over all 53 records: 0.6152795936767026. P is now the lowest observed Logloss: 0.19649601237450445, lower than the previous loss minimum. These identify different fitted models.

All latest arms have 17130275 learned parameters, including 51587 dense parameters. Their wall times are 738.62 to 744.53 seconds and training times 645.21 to 650.34 seconds. All-call correction extraction/diagnostics incur extra measured cost relative to historical cheaper none.

Candidate-authored through-checkpoint summaries report 14661 training calls per arm, about 821 eligible/conflicting rows per call, 10.4 to 10.5 percent conflict complete-gradient energy, and correction RMS ratios N=0, P=0.0501571, D=0.0499860, M=0.0138848. Extra-degenerate-row totals are zero.

Candidate-authored maximum direction/magnitude norm errors over these calls are below 3e-7. Synthetic checks report zero listed errors. Two early caches report zero scalar BCE discrepancy, outside-eligible and padding correction; first-512 validation checks report zero same-state forward discrepancy. These are different scopes, not independent verification.

M-N AUC reverses for empty histories, early hours, past-pv-absent and category-match-absent. Empty histories contain 8272 exposures and 310 positives. Slices overlap; these exploratory differences have no cluster intervals or established power.

Latest knowledge usage declares four executed variants and considers CRAFT/QueryFormer without transferring their forward architectures. Primary text inspection confirms different forward mechanisms and task/capacity regimes; no source-priority or causal-knowledge-value claim follows.

interpretations.statement: At seed 42, the complete-row direction/magnitude factorial provides conditional local support for a magnitude contribution to validation ranking: M-N and P-D are positive, while D-N and P-M are negative.
interpretations.qualification: This reverses the broad directional-benefit reading of round 16 under a better specified complete-gradient control. It does not establish general magnitude sufficiency or harmfulness of projection across seeds.

interpretations.statement: Magnitude-only correction reaches the current maximum AUC without changing the declared complete-row raw-gradient direction at a fixed state.
interpretations.qualification: A logical counterexample to direction being necessary for this observed AUC maximum, conditional on the candidate checks. Raw-gradient direction preservation does not preserve Adam update direction, optimizer trajectory, or predictions across fitted models.

interpretations.statement: The positive AUC interaction means projected direction is less adverse when combined with projected magnitude than at baseline magnitude; it remains adverse in both observed direction contrasts.
interpretations.qualification: A positive interaction alone is not a positive main effect, causal mediation, or a reason to select the direction arm.

observations.statement: All 57 authorized committed trials report success and null errors; the previous runtime error is null. All trajectory index values agree with independently resolved receipts. Scientific negatives and aggregate nonreproduction are distinct from failed execution.

History pooling improves validation AUC over static by 0.0052224992; target-aware pooling improves over simple pooling by 0.0031358724. Both lower Logloss. These references establish useful history signal in this benchmark, without identifying a specific field/action bottleneck.
Full count correction reduces AUC for both history references. The weaker-strength follow-up improves simple pooling but still reduces target-aware AUC. Retain these unsuccessful scientific branches.

Aligned product restriction improves its immediate ordinary adapter, while the ordinary adapter is not numerically identical to original DIN. Unit normalization improves aligned far more than crossed products. This is conditional evidence about those particular replacements.

Fixed-scale and history-mean replacements nearly recover earlier full-rule AUC at seed42, with mixed loss; action grouping and donor/order branches have negative and recovered outcomes. Exact event-specific inverse norm, donor ownership and temporal semantics are not established as necessary.

Round16 projection beats a product-sum norm control, but that control does not match complete shared-row gradients after other paths are added. Round17 complete-row controls give positive magnitude AUC contrasts and negative direction contrasts. These are different controls and do not support a common unqualified directional-benefit interpretation.

The magnitude replay fails exact aggregate reproduction despite equal config: round18 minus round17 AUC -0.0003729890298 and Logloss +0.0001651167567, with different source hashes. The none replay exactly reproduces both aggregate metrics and all 23 exported slices. This is an intervention-specific reproducibility discrepancy, not an identified cause.

Current ordering is N > U > M > R in AUC. M-N=-0.0001955838606, U-N=-0.0000989026198, R-N=-0.0003399032124; all three increase Logloss versus N. U-M=+0.0000966812409 AUC and -0.0000929859279 Logloss. Neither specified generic replacement beats unchanged gradients in this execution.

The magnitude contrast changes sign from round17 M-N=+0.0001774051692 to round18 M-N=-0.0001955838606. Bridge drift exceeds the original gain. Pooling those versions or comparing new replacements directly to the old winning magnitude score as if source-matched would confound attribution.

The numerical AUC maximum across all 57 receipts remains original round17 magnitude at 0.6152795936767026. The lowest observed Logloss remains round17 projection at 0.19649601237450445. Current unchanged gradients beat every current replacement on both metrics. These are separate selection and reproducibility facts.

Candidate diagnostics report 14661 through-checkpoint calls per current arm, about 48383-48390 active and 821-823 eligible rows per call. Rotation reports zero scalar-moment errors, about 98.1% of its nontrivial receivers outside conflict; uniform reports same-state hypothetical magnitude-energy errors below 1.46e-7. These are candidate-authored checks, not independent verification.

Common initial complete-gradient norms agree between the old/new magnitude receipts, but their call512 norms differ (0.0004502640204 versus 0.0004486271456). Matching one scalar norm does not establish identical initial tensors or gradients. The caches place reported divergence by call512 without locating the first cause.

All current arms have 17130275 learned parameters. Round18 wall times span 775.81-794.02s, training 682.09-700.87s, and peak GPU memory about 1.105-1.115GB. Same capacity/data passes do not establish equal compute or serving equivalence.

Exploratory slices show heterogeneous changes despite full-population losses: all current replacements lose empty-history AUC; uniform improves short-history and low-frequency AUC while worsening full-population AUC. Empty history has 8272 impressions/310 positives; history1-16 has 41805/1444. No effective-user precision or cluster interval is available.

Latest knowledge usage records the four actual round18 trial IDs and hashes; DIN and scoped agent memory are declared used, CRAFT/QueryFormer only considered. Execution does not by itself establish the intended magnitude replay or the value of knowledge access.

observations.statement: The 65 individually resolved authorized receipts contain 61 successes and four failed executions. All trajectory-index status/AUC/wall values and all 16 runtime-history records agree with the receipts. Every successful validation has 3,234,051 impressions.

All four round21 variants fail with the same RuntimeError: Trace v1 supports float32/64 only; preserve failure. Validation, candidate diagnostics, parameter count, training time and peak memory are null. There is no exported trace or score to compare. The sum of their receipt wall times is 21.4754219353199 seconds; null costs are not zeros.

Within the latest magnitude pair, source hash and configuration are identical; the same holds within the none pair. The pairs therefore document repeated failed attempts at the declared seed42, rather than successful reproducibility checks. Between interventions, source hashes and row_intervention differ; source bodies are unavailable for independent difference verification.

The runtime separately reports a round20 admission error, Model uses forbidden attribute: __setattr__. No committed round20 trial appears in the authorized 65-trial index. Do not fabricate a receipt, result or cost for that admission event.

The original magnitude run remains the historical AUC maximum at 0.6152795936767026. Its exact-source/config seed42 replay reports 0.6149279138846995, a decrease of 0.0003516797920031225. This was a successful execution with nonreproducing performance, unlike the latest runtime failures.

The none control reproduces AUC 0.6151021885074872, Logloss 0.19653258393542125, and all 23 exported slice dictionaries across rounds17,18,19. This is aggregate and slice replay, not verified identity of predictions or full host state.

Historical magnitude minus none AUC is positive in round17, but current audited magnitude minus none is negative in round19. Exact original-source replay also falls below current none. Every successful round19 magnitude execution has worse population Logloss than none. Latest failures cannot reverse these measured outcomes.

The round19 candidate-supplied common-state audit reports two snapshots at calls0/512, near-repeat-floor M17/M18 complete-gradient differences and zero cross-source Adam parameter-update differences. It does not supply full-trajectory trace identity or an independent checker. Round21 supplies no additional diagnostic values.

Feature-only, simple-history pooling and target-aware history baselines have AUC 0.6050036145, 0.6102261137 and 0.6133619861 respectively. Full count correction loses AUC for both history references. Half correction helps pooling versus ordinary pooling but still loses target-aware AUC. These are scientific negative and mixed results from successful implementations.

Same-field product restriction and aligned normalization improve their matched local references at seed42. Constant tangent and history-mean backward replacements nearly match full normalization, while crossed products, identity-gradient replacements and several action/history reassignments do not. Per-event inverse norms, action semantics and temporal ownership are not established as necessary.

The round16 product-role-sum norm control and round17 complete-row norm controls are distinct. Round17 direction-only minus none and projection minus magnitude AUC are negative, while magnitude minus none is positive in that original round. Projection itself changes across the round16-to17 source bridge. This does not isolate a generally beneficial projected direction.

Round18 uniform-energy and rotated-magnitude implementations both lose population AUC and Logloss to none. Uniform exceeds the current magnitude bridge on AUC, while rotation falls below it. Their controls match different quantities and the magnitude bridge does not reproduce the original result.

The original projection bridge has the lowest observed Logloss, 0.19649601237450445, whereas original magnitude has the highest observed AUC. Best observed AUC and best observed probability loss refer to different receipts.

The latest usage record declares scoped memory and DIN used, and QueryFormer/UniDot considered; its four executed-variant IDs, hashes and failed statuses match committed receipts. This confirms recorded provenance, not successful knowledge transfer or mechanism confirmation.

alternatives.explanation: The trace encounters an ordinary non-floating tensor such as an integer identity/index or boolean mask, and an over-restrictive serializer rejects it.
alternatives.status: Plausible; the specific dtype and component are unobserved.
alternatives.discriminating_check: Through a later authorized interface, emit only bounded component name/dtype/shape and failure location, and exercise the trace encoder on every observed permitted dtype without training if a counted preflight is available. Preserve tensor types and exact identity; do not cast identities to floating point or silently skip inputs.

alternatives.explanation: A lower-precision, complex, structured, empty or otherwise unsupported component follows a different trace path; broad integer support alone may not repair the failure.
alternatives.status: Possible; receipt message does not distinguish these cases.

decision.status: Historical numerical AUC leader only. Original-source performance has not reproduced; no final suite selection, checkpoint freeze, deployment or test assessment.
decision.mechanism_status: No repeated benefit established for complete-row magnitude allocation. Latest successful contrasts are negative in both tracing conditions. Tracing compatibility is locally supported; whole-run nonperturbation and the cause of magnitude drift remain unresolved.
decision.selection_action: Do not change the runtime incumbent in this analysis-only phase. Treat none as the reproducibility comparator for future fixed comparisons; do not promote a historical maximum into a robust winner.

observations.statement: All 69 authorized receipts were individually resolved: 65 successes and four execution failures. All successful validations use 3,234,051 impressions. The 16 runtime-history records match their full receipts and the entire trajectory index matches status/AUC/wall values.

All four round22 variants succeed. Both typed traces report schema2, compatibility_selftest_pass=1, initial_gate_pass=1, exact initial input/logit/loss and parameter bits flags, and zero gate-after/repeat gradient relative error. This establishes candidate-reported local gate success and execution compatibility; it is not an independent whole-run nonperturbation certificate.

Round22 magnitude minus none AUC is -0.000030525094314337586 with tracing off and -0.00017054648215741874 with tracing v2. Corresponding Logloss differences are +0.000011692370851718037 and +0.00006511215071500209. Both specified magnitude implementations lose on both population metrics.

Tracing-v2 minus tracing-off magnitude is -0.00014002138784308116 AUC and +0.000053419779863284056 Logloss. For none the corresponding metric differences are exactly zero, and all 23 slice dictionaries replay. These are one-run cell comparisons, not proof of a tracer causal effect.

The original magnitude source hash 6e9e41cc4cf0e92b1036f82de88e6c214343288d1fa7de2865237d3d580106d2 and config appear in round17, round19 exact17 replay and round22 trace-off magnitude. Their AUCs are 0.6152795936767026, 0.6149279138846995 and 0.6150716634131729. Source edits therefore cannot be the sole necessary explanation of all score drift; unobserved execution state and numerical causes remain possible.

Typed M and N input sketches agree at all five captured calls 0,1,512,8192,14660. Initial parameter and logit sketches agree. observations.statement: All 77 authorized own-arm receipts were resolved: 73 successes and four execution failures. Exposed runtime history and trajectory-index status/AUC/wall fields agree with complete receipts. All successful validation sets have 3,234,051 impressions.

All four schema3 round24 jobs succeed. Within each intervention a/b have identical source/config. All have 17,130,275 parameters (17,078,688 embedding; 51,587 dense). Only registered row_intervention differs in their configs. Source-level isolation remains a declared construction claim because candidate source is not exposed.

Magnitude_a minus none_a: AUC -0.0002175325137407924, Logloss +0.000142259015946139. Magnitude_b minus none_b: AUC -0.00008748582675377481, Logloss +0.000041344405356302794. Both lose on both population metrics.

The two schema3 magnitude AUCs are 0.6148846559937464 and 0.6150147026807334; their same-source same-seed range is 0.000130046686987018. Both none runs reproduce AUC 0.6151021885074872 and Logloss 0.19653258393542125, all 23 slice dictionaries and selected_parameter_checksum1=778240573. None diagnostic dictionaries do NOT match: inactive role/projected/scale summaries and aggregation distances vary.

All eight call0/1 probes report zero fixed-observer checksum mismatches, zero fixed-observer bit mutations and zero input/parameter/logit mutations. All four runs pass inherited v2 compatibility and initial gates. This supplies the previously missing real-tensor within-run observer check, within the candidate-owned two-call scope.

At all eight probes, fixed-role aggregation repeats have nonzero reported differences: abs_max range [8.242295734817162e-13, 1.9895196601282805e-12], relative range [6.134745326702719e-07, 1.1298074058211472e-06], and bits_mismatches=8 at every probe. These actual-value distances occur in both none and magnitude; their small absolute magnitude must be retained rather than inferred from checksum differences.

At all eight probes, raw backward repeat abs_max/relative are zero; fixed-G/q/h transform repeat abs_max/relative and mask mismatches are zero; result_repeat_relative is zero. Thus frozen-correction/fixed-operand repeat success coexists with nonrepeatability when row aggregation is recomputed. Different controls test different stages.

Within the same-source magnitude pair, input, parameter and raw-table-gradient checksum pairs match at call0 and call1, while roles, projected target, scale, expected-table-gradient and result-gradient sketches differ at both calls. Within none, role/projected/scale sketches differ but expected/result-gradient sketches match. Matching sketches do not certify exact cross-execution common state, and no between-run actual tensor distances or Adam-step differences are exported.

Magnitude surrogate relative errors at calls0/1 are about 6.23e-9 to 8.48e-9; inherited two-probe maximum is at most 1.72686997938165e-8. None errors are zero. All jobs report two captured slots, 14,661 training calls and 60,045,735 training examples through selected checkpoint; these are candidate counters, not host total processed-example accounting.

All three exact schema2 magnitude runs at rounds22/23 also lose to none on AUC and Logloss. Their diagnostics/source version differ from schema3; do not pool them as five interchangeable independent seeds. Original round17 magnitude retains the historical maximum AUC 0.6152795936767026, with worse Logloss than none, and repeated original-source score reproduction has failed.

The baseline static/pooling/target-aware AUCs are 0.6050036144838207, 0.6102261137080656 and 0.6133619861190683. Full count correction loses in pooling and target-aware histories; half correction improves pooling but loses target-aware AUC. Missing input and execution failure are not explanations for these successful negative results.

Historical field alignment and unit normalization have favorable local contrasts. Constant/history-mean replacements nearly match fuller normalization; query-only/history-only half routes lose to combined half routing. Direction-only, rotated and uniform-energy controls lose to none. These are different mechanism contrasts, while deterministic replays are repeatability evidence.

observations.statement: All 88 committed own-arm receipts resolve and match the runtime/index:84 successes and four trace-v1 failures. Each success scores 3,234,051 validation impressions. Only declared seed 42 is observed; replay counts are not independent initializations.
Static, pooled-history and target-aware reference AUCs are 0.6050036145,0.6102261137 and0.6133619861. History is useful under this benchmark, without identifying a semantic bottleneck.
Round30 aligned half improves full by +0.0001204973277 AUC and -0.00003082365591 Logloss. Both executions succeed; parameters and declared recipe match.
Round29 crossed half improves full by +0.0004667050401 AUC and -0.0003271451568 Logloss. The direction is positive in both pairing contexts.

The common-implementation interaction (crossed half-minus-full) minus (aligned half-minus-full) is +0.0003462077124 AUC and -0.0002963215009 Logloss. It exactly reproduces the earlier descriptive mixed-source arithmetic.

Aligned half exceeds crossed half by +0.0012437529830 AUC and -0.0001256945697 Logloss; aligned full exceeds crossed full by +0.0015899606954 AUC and -0.0004220160707 Logloss. Half does not erase the observed pairing advantage.

Round30 aligned full exactly replays historical normalized-aligned AUC/Logloss/sample count/all 23 slice dictionaries. Aligned half replays round12 and observer-free round28 aggregates/slices. Source hashes differ and inference timings differ; state equality is unobserved.

Aligned half improves AUC in15/23 overlapping slices and loss in16/23. Empty-history and history1_16 regress on both metrics. Crossed half improves AUC in20/23 and loss in23/23; it still loses empty-history AUC. Slice benefits are not uniform.

Schema8 diagnostics in all four cells report the expected pairing/gradient flags, no observers/row intervention, zero sampled same-state forward discrepancies, finite logits, zero masked mass and empty summaries. Scope is 512 ordered validation impressions, including four empty histories and 60475 valid events; no natural floor/boundary events are sampled.

Aligned checkpoints report mean absolute own/donor scale changes 0.0674973 and 0.0670525, moment relative errors at most 2.312e-7, synthetic donor error 0 and synthetic VJP relative error 1.4383e-16. These are bounded candidate-supplied checks, not independent full-training derivative or optimizer measurements.

Aligned-half wall/train times exceed aligned-full by 2.4555/1.4001 seconds, with 902733312 versus 900373504 peak GPU bytes. Inference is 178645 versus 182643 examples/s. Batch 4096 p50/p95 is 21.360/22.152 versus 20.899/21.853ms including causal feature gathering. One timing pair establishes no efficiency advantage.

Historical magnitude AUC 0.6152795937 becomes 0.6149279139 on same-source/config exact17 replay. Round26 magnitude-minus-none is +0.0000243281 AUC; round27 is -0.0001685359. Retain positive and negative results; a repeatable magnitude increment is unestablished.

Latest knowledge-usage variant names, hashes and statuses match both round30 receipts; status is documented with no undocumented industry IDs. Declared source use is provenance, not causal proof of knowledge value.

observations.statement: All 90 authorized own-arm receipts resolve: 86 successes and four trace-v1 execution failures. Runtime history and indexed status/AUC/wall fields agree with receipts. Replays and source variants are dependent observations at declared seed 42.

Latest flag-on/off pair has exactly equal reported population AUC/Logloss, all 23 slice dictionaries, parameter counts and peak GPU memory. Both retain the round30 aligned-half slice records. Aggregate equality does not certify equal per-example predictions.

Recorded inference time decreases by 0.3991248459 seconds (2.13818%); throughput increases by 2.18490%. Batch p50 falls by 0.4709065 ms (2.14216%) and p95 by 0.2583563 ms (1.13669%). Wall time instead rises by 0.4001617 seconds and training by 1.6404516 seconds. One pair is a timing observation with unresolved execution variation.

Both schema9 diagnostic records succeed and report 37 finite scalars; only inference_shortcut_enabled differs. On 512 ordered validation impressions with 60,475 valid events and four empty histories, reported helper/product/active-logit errors and masked mass/empty-summary norms are zero. No natural floor/boundary events occur in this sample.

Both report zero shortcut synthetic no-grad product error and enabled-gradient product/VJP errors, finite fraction 1, four synthetic floor cases and one boundary case. The inherited analytic VJP relative errors are about 1.44e-16. These are bounded candidate-authored checks, not independent verification of every model state.

The accumulated aligned-half/no-row quality anchor exceeds the original target-aware reference by 0.0017402023884 AUC and reduces Logloss by 0.0002620625394. That contrast bundles inherited changes; round31 adds no score improvement.

The common-family four-cell contrast has half-minus-full AUC +0.0001204973277 aligned and +0.0004667050401 crossed. Crossed-minus-aligned interaction is +0.0003462077124 at seed 42. Both losses improve, and aligned half has the best population metrics among these four cells.

Aligned half improves 15/23 slice AUCs and 16/23 losses; crossed half improves 20/23 AUCs and 23/23 losses. Aligned empty and 1–16-history slices regress on both metrics. Uniform subgroup superiority is contradicted; empty-history effects may reflect shared learned parameters and do not establish an active history mechanism.

Baseline static/pooled/target-aware AUCs are 0.6050036145/0.6102261137/0.6133619861. Full count correction loses in both backbones; partial correction helps pooling but loses target-aware AUC. The proposed correction did not transfer uniformly across architectures.

Aligned products and normalization improve this local trajectory; constant/history-mean derivative controls nearly match fuller normalization. Combined half routing outperforms query-only or history-only variants on AUC. These contrasts leave generic conditioning and shared-embedding adaptation plausible.

The historical magnitude maximum AUC 0.6152795937 was not reproduced by its exact-source replay (0.6149279139). Round26 magnitude has a small positive delta +0.0000243280764, while frozen round27 has delta -0.0001685358866 and worse loss. Same-source round23 duplicates also differ. Preserve positives, negatives and lineage; no reliable incremental magnitude advantage is established.
Direction-only, rotated-magnitude and uniform-energy interventions lose AUC to their none comparators. These controls concern raw gradients and do not match actual Adam updates.

Candidate-owned same-state magnitude shadows show tiny role/gradient/moment changes. A represented Adam-update difference of 1.4901161193847656e-8 is reported at call512; early calls0/1 and call8192 update differences are zero. Fixed-tree aggregation is shadow-only. The new inference result does not establish training-wide numerical repair or final-score mediation.

Observer removal in round28 retains reported parent population/slice metrics with lower recorded cost. Round31 supplies a contemporaneous control for a different optimization, inference surrogate removal; it does not retroactively deconfound the older observer timing contrast.

Four trace-v1 jobs fail with RuntimeError('Trace v1 supports float32/64 only; preserve failure') before validation. Their combined wall time is 21.4754219353 seconds. Metrics and unreported train/memory costs remain null, not zero or scientific losses.

observations.statement: All 92 authorized own-arm receipt references resolve: 88 successes and four execution failures. Indexed status, AUC and wall fields agree. Every successful validation reports 3,234,051 impressions. These dependent replays, source versions and controls are not 92 independent mechanisms or initializations.

Round32 candidate and contemporaneous reference succeed with identical population AUC, Logloss and all 23 reported slice dictionaries. They also retain the round30 aligned-half slice records, 17,130,275 parameters (17,078,688 embedding; 51,587 dense), and 902,733,312 peak GPU bytes. Reported aggregate equality is weaker than full per-example prediction equality.

Round32 candidate minus reference: train -3.7599244416 s (-0.6947527%), wall -2.7560773939 s (-0.4361564%), inference +0.4148674458 s (+2.3119603%), throughput -2.2597166%, batch p50 +0.2987385 ms and p95 +0.2543136 ms. Notes declare a fixed execution order, reference then candidate. Timing uncertainty and order effects are unmeasured.

Both latest schema10 records succeed with 55 finite scalar values; only identity_vjp_enabled differs. Synthetic float32 and float64 primitive/product forward and VJP errors, same-checkpoint model logit error, and all 31 parameter-tensor VJP errors are reported as zero. This is candidate-supplied bounded evidence, not an independent implementation audit.

Latest diagnostics cover 512 ordered validation impressions, 60,475 valid events, four empty histories, one eligible singleton and 507 eligible multiple-event rows. There are zero natural floor/boundary cases. Synthetic shortcut checks include four floor cases and one boundary case; logits/VJPs are finite and padding/empty-summary checks report zero. Natural rare-path coverage is limited.

Round31 inference shortcut also preserves population/slice metrics. Its single-pair inference time falls by 0.3991248459 s (2.1381788%), but train and total wall rise. Round32 uses the inference shortcut in both arms; its timing contrast does not retest the round31 flag-on/off effect.

Baseline static, pooled-history and target-aware validation AUCs are 0.6050036145, 0.6102261137 and 0.6133619861. The aligned-half/no-row anchor improves the original target-aware reference by 0.0017402023884 AUC and -0.0002620625394 Logloss. This historical contrast bundles changes and execution times.

In the declared common executable family, half-minus-full AUC is +0.0001204973277 for aligned and +0.0004667050401 for crossed pairing. The crossed-minus-aligned interaction is +0.0003462077124 AUC and -0.0002963215009 Logloss. Aligned half is best on both population metrics among the four cells. No independent seed has been observed.

Aligned half improves 15/23 overlapping slice AUCs and 16/23 losses; crossed half improves 20/23 AUCs and 23/23 losses. Aligned empty-history and history1_16 AUC and Logloss both worsen. These are exploratory subgroup findings, with only 310 positives in the empty-history slice.

Full history-count correction loses AUC in both pooled and target-aware models. Partial correction improves pooled AUC but loses target-aware AUC. These are successfully executed negative/mixed results, not missing data or execution failures.

Same-field products improve over ordinary products locally, and aligned unit-normalized products outperform crossed controls. Constant/history-mean derivative alternatives nearly match full normalization; combined half routing outperforms query-only/history-only AUC. These controls leave generic conditioning, shared representation adaptation and optimizer dynamics plausible.

Historical magnitude AUC 0.6152795936767026 becomes 0.6149279138846995 in exact-source/config replay. Same-source round23 magnitude duplicates also differ. Round26 magnitude-minus-none is +0.0000243280764 AUC and -0.0000015627888 Logloss; round27 is -0.0001685358866 AUC and +0.0000613134750 Logloss. Preserve all signs; a reliable incremental magnitude benefit is unestablished.

Direction-only, rotated-magnitude and uniform-energy variants lose AUC against their none controls. Raw-gradient norm/direction controls do not match actual Adam updates, so they do not isolate semantic conflict resolution.

Candidate-owned aggregation shadows report a represented Adam-update difference of 1.4901161193847656e-8 at call512, but zero at call8192 and earlier calls0/1. Fixed-tree aggregation remains shadow-only. These mixed local probes establish neither training-wide numerical repair nor final-score mediation.

Round28 observer-free none retains reported parent population/slice metrics with lower recorded train/wall/memory. Historical timing across source versions is confounded. Latest transport checks do not resolve the cause of magnitude score variation.

Four round21 trace-v1 jobs fail with the recorded float32/64 support RuntimeError and null validation. Their recorded wall total is 21.4754219353 s. Later typed tracing succeeds; this does not erase failures or identify the original offending tensor/dtype.

Latest knowledge-usage IDs, source hashes, statuses and variant names agree with both executed round32 receipts; status is documented with no undocumented industry IDs. Declared use is provenance rather than evidence of causal knowledge value.

mechanism_definition.global_half: scale_half_tangent preserves recipient tangent directions and reassigns inverse-norm scales by stable rank/half rotation within eligible histories. Half denotes donor-rank reassignment, not multiplying the entire gradient by0.5. row_intervention=none disables the separate complete-row intervention only.
mechanism_definition.latest_difference: Use native full normalization derivatives when supplied history_mask count<=16; otherwise retain global-half donor derivatives. observations.statement: Resolved all94 committed own-arm receipts:90 successful validations and four trace-v1 execution failures. Current history exactly matches corresponding complete receipts. Every successful validation has3,234,051 impressions. The94 jobs are dependent controls, source variants and replays, not independent seeds.
Static, simple-pooling and target-aware reference AUCs are0.6050036145,0.6102261137 and0.6133619861. This benchmark benefits from history and target conditioning at seed42.

The latest candidate loses0.00015098405147961902 population AUC and increases Logloss by0.0001934596949558498 versus its CONFIG-matched global-half control. Both executions succeeded; this is a scientific negative, not missing data or an execution failure.

The control exactly reproduces round30 aligned-half AUC, Logloss, sample count and all23 slice dictionaries; source hashes and timings differ. Aggregate replay does not establish identical predictions, checkpoint states or independent-seed support.

For1-16 events, fallback gains0.00011780797416893751 AUC and reduces loss by0.00017644754093162907 versus global half. Empty-history AUC falls0.0018715916733517135 while loss improves0.0005649602707495649. Both short bins remain worse than historical global full on both metrics.

The<=16 group has50,077 impressions and1,754 positives,1.54843% of validation. Its weighted loss contribution improves3.7258969658447422e-6, outweighed by the>16 group worsening1.9718559192132468e-4. This exactly decomposes overall mean Logloss; overall AUC cannot be decomposed by weighting within-slice AUCs.

Only4/23 overlapping slices improve AUC and4/23 improve Logloss. All four hour bins lose AUC and loss. Frequency1-2 gains AUC but loses loss; frequency>=100 improves both. These are exploratory counts of overlapping slices, not independent replications or significance tests.

Schema11 reports active routing flags0/1, cutoff16, no observers/row intervention, zero sampled fixed-state forward error and finite logits. The ordered512-input sample contains10 short rows, four empty rows and41 short regular events; natural floor/boundary events are absent. Synthetic f32/f64 routing checks include lengths16/17; maximum reported f32 scaled VJP error is1.23618e-6. These checks are candidate-authored, not independent verification.

Capacity is17,130,275 parameters in both latest arms. Fallback costs5.6431642 more train seconds and6.7756455 more wall seconds, about1.07%/1.10%, with4096 more peak GPU bytes. Inference throughput falls198559 to196102 examples/s; batch p50/p95 rise19.037/19.913 to19.309/20.352ms. One timing pair supports no stable efficiency conclusion.

Full count balancing harms both pooling and target-aware references; half balancing improves pooling but harms target-aware AUC. Aligned products improve the local reference, while constant/history-mean controls nearly match fuller normalization; action-conditioned allocation is negative. These branches limit a universal behavior-balancing or semantic-retrieval story.

The inherited common-implementation pairing-by-gradient factorial favors half in both pairings. Crossed gain0.0004667050401 exceeds aligned gain0.0001204973277; the AUC interaction is+0.0003462077124. This is one-seed performance nonadditivity, not semantic or optimizer mediation.

Historical magnitude AUC maximum0.6152795937 drops to0.6149279139 on same-source exact17 replay. Round26 magnitude has a small positive contrast while round27 is negative; same-source duplicate magnitude results also vary. The historical maximum remains recorded, with no stable incremental magnitude benefit established.

Inference shortcut and identity-transport branches preserve reported quality. Round32 has sub-percent train/wall savings but slower inference in one pair; round31 inference gain is also unrepeated. Preserve these as implementation trajectories, with no robust cost frontier.

Four trace-v1 receipts fail before validation with RuntimeError: Trace v1 supports float32/64 only; preserve failure. Their measured wall sum is21.4754219353199 seconds; metrics are null. They consume budget and provide no performance estimate.

Latest knowledge usage is documented with no undocumented industry IDs. Both executed variant names, hashes and statuses match committed receipts. The agent-r0030 directional routing use was executed, but its joint short-recovery/population-preservation prediction did not succeed.

interpretations.statement: The declared joint objective of repairing sparse metrics while retaining population quality is unsuccessful in this implementation. The1-16 improvement is real in the reported seed42 metrics but small, and empty-history ranking worsens.
interpretations.scope: One declared matched pair, conditional on source-isolation provenance; no statistical or general mechanism refutation.

interpretations.statement: The failure weakens treating the earlier short-slice full-versus-half gap as a directly patchable local backward defect. Shared-parameter training and checkpoint selection can transmit a short-row intervention throughout the population. Empty-history changes are compatible with that coupling.
interpretations.scope: Plausible explanation; no train-state mediation or group-specific update measurements.

interpretations.statement: The derivative gate is active and passes bounded checks, making an obviously disabled intervention less likely. Candidate-authored synthetic and512-input checks cannot prove training-wide implementation correctness.

The accumulated global-half backbone has repeatable seed42 aggregate performance above original target-aware baseline. This supports a local operational reference, not independent-seed robustness, a unique semantic mechanism or a statistical equivalence claim.

Further cutoff/coefficient/architecture searches on the same validation seed would add adaptive selection without resolving the main uncertainty: whether the existing gain survives paired initializations and closed assessment.

Both latest jobs succeed with 17,130,275 parameters. Half yields AUC 0.6151021885074872 and Logloss 0.19653258393542125; full yields 0.6149816911798147 and 0.19656340759133067. Signed half-minus-full differences are +0.00012049732767249743 AUC and -0.000030823655909423264 Logloss.

Round34 half exactly matches round30 half and round33 global-half population AUC/Logloss/sample count and all 23 slice dictionaries. Round34 full exactly matches round30 full on the same exported metrics. Different source hashes and timing remain; full prediction, checkpoint and optimizer-state equality is unavailable.

Half improves AUC in 15/23 overlapping slices and Logloss in 16/23. Empty and 1-16 history bins worsen on both metrics; 17-64 and >64 bins improve both. These are exploratory slice comparisons without user-cluster intervals, not 23 independent replications.

The four disjoint history bins decompose the population mean-loss change: empty +2.7048503504242617e-6, 1-16 +5.5721368158064065e-6, 17-64 -1.6693395817341823e-6 and >64 -3.7431303493904556e-5. Short/empty rows total 50,077 impressions and 1,754 positives (1.54843% of validation). AUC cannot be decomposed this way.

Relative to baseline-din, latest half gains 0.0017402023884188766 AUC and lowers Logloss by 0.00026206253941110647. This is an accumulated-model contrast, not attribution of that entire gain to the half derivative.

The inherited pairing-by-gradient factorial has crossed half-minus-full +0.00046670504006685043 AUC versus aligned +0.00012049732767249743. The interaction, defined as crossed gain minus aligned gain, is +0.000346207712394353 AUC. Aligned pairing still outperforms crossed under both derivative modes.

Round34 diagnostics report schema12, half flags 1/0, sparse fallback/row intervention/training observers disabled, zero sampled fixed-state forward error, finite logits, zero masked mass and empty summaries. The 512 ordered validation inputs contain 10 short rows, four empty histories, 60,475 regular events and no natural floor or boundary events. Synthetic f32/f64 checks report maximum scaled VJP errors about 1.23618e-6/1.13687e-13. Shared synthetic routing checks test helpers; they do not independently verify the selected training path.

Latest half records 521.7000 train seconds and 609.9074 wall seconds versus full 525.6177/614.4650: about 0.745%/0.742% less in one pair. Half uses 2,359,808 more peak GPU bytes, has slightly lower inference throughput (191,970 vs 192,308 examples/s), lower p50 and higher p95 batch latency. No stable speed advantage follows; the prior round30 training-time direction was opposite.

The round33 short-history full-gradient fallback regresses population AUC by 0.00015098405147961813 and raises Logloss by 0.0001934596949558507 versus global half. A small 1-16-event benefit did not repair empty-history ranking or preserve population performance. Round34 full now reproduces the historical global-full comparator; no additional fallback run occurred.

Full count correction harms both pooling and target-aware references. Half correction improves pooled AUC but harms target-aware AUC. The original behavior-balancing hypothesis does not have uniform support.

Aligned products improve the local ordinary-product AUC; constant-tangent and history-mean controls nearly match normalized-full AUC, while action-mean allocation is worse. These alternatives weaken a unique action-semantic or fine-grained semantic-retrieval explanation.

Historical magnitude best AUC 0.6152795936767026 has Logloss 0.19653896282671007, slightly worse than the no-row half reference. Same-source/config exact17 replay scores 0.6149279138846995, a drop of 0.0003516797920031234. Round26 magnitude-minus-none is +0.000024328076400625953 AUC and round27 is -0.00016853588656640106. Retain all outcomes; a stable incremental magnitude benefit is unestablished.
